system.description:
You were once part of a revenant family. Following the Embrace, you suffered the double burden of your clan's weakness and your revenant family's limitation as well — whether the Oprichniki's haunting, the Bratovitch's propensity to fly into a rage, the Grimaldi's blood bond to the Sabbat at large, the Obertus's obsessive instability, or the Zantosa's weak will against temptation. The Storyteller might also let you manifest a weakness from a lost or destroyed revenant line, adding mystery to your background and room for genealogical detective work.

MET System: As above, you suffer both your clan's weakness and your revenant family's limitation. Work with your Storyteller if you decide to manifest a limitation drawn from a lost or destroyed revenant line.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
